visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an indoor room with a plain white wall and a gray door. A woman with long blonde hair, wearing an oversized white graphic t-shirt and white platform shoes, jumps energetically onto a cat-shaped floor mat. (2) Through a jump cut, she transforms into a school uniform consisting of a white shirt, a gray sweater vest, and a plaid skirt, posing while standing on one leg. (3) Another jump cut shows her in a classic black and white maid outfit with a white apron, smiling and posing with her hands on her waist. (4) She transitions into a black mini dress with a wide belt and black leather boots, wearing stylized silver sunglasses and posing near the door handle. (5) The setting shifts to a dimly lit gaming room with colorful backlighting; she is now seen in a close-up wearing a white over-ear headset with a microphone. (6) Detailed shots follow, showcasing the headset's RGB lighting effects, the textured fabric of the ear cups, and the various control buttons on the side. (7) The video then cycles through her posing in the previously shown outfits (maid, school uniform, black dress) while consistently wearing the white headset and smiling at the camera. (8) A sequence of mobile interface screen captures appears, showing settings for equalizers, lighting, and battery status within a dedicated application. (9) She holds up a black hard-shell carrying case with a logo, pointing at it while wearing her school uniform and the headset. (10) The final scene returns to the door where she stands in the maid outfit, wearing the headset and holding a vacuum cleaner, looking towards the camera with a cheerful expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, uptempo electronic dance music track featuring a heavy 4/4 synthetic kick drum. (2) A female narrator with an enthusiastic and bright tone introduces the G522 headset, using a high speech rate and clear articulation. (3) A 'whoosh' sound effect occurs simultaneously with visual outfit transitions, punctuating the rhythm of the editing. (4) Light 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects are used to highlight the appearance of feature-rich text overlays on the screen. (5) As technical specifications are described, the music remains constant while the narrator's pitch fluctuates to emphasize key selling points like 'RGB' and 'Blue VO!CE'. (6) The vocal track maintains high arousal and a professional yet friendly tone throughout, perfectly synchronized with the fast-paced visual sequence. (7) Towards the end, the intensity slightly peaks as the promotional offer is mentioned, before concluding with a final upbeat musical phrase.
